title: The buy-back rental element set, the rental table, the AMIS and ATS path, the receipt loop and the rental event are not specified for rwb-treatment
source: Legacy RWB-E3-016 sections 1 to 19 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md, heading RWB-E3-016); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.16 (A2.16.1 to A2.16.4) and the feature row FEAT-TRT-16; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1, T4 DEEDINLIEU, T5.1 and Appendix T-A; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-32, R-DIL-33 and R-DIL-34; Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 feature rows FEAT-TRT-16, FEAT-AST-10, FEAT-AST-23 and FEAT-AST-24; Business Requirements Program v4 section 5.9 (REQ-S2-008 and REQ-S2-010); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 13, 41 and 42; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-03, DP-05 and R7.2 s12
section: 3 Preconditions; 4 Flow; 5 Exception paths; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC3; 8 Business rules; 11 Data; 12.3; 12.4; 12.5; 12.7; 13 Solution plan
description: One combined row for the buy-back rental. (1) TSD S2 T3.1 stops at DF-TRT-033 and has no rental reference, no auto-debit mandate reference and no mandate status, although R-DIL-32 creates the rental record and sets the auto-debit and the stage must report both. (2) No source states whether the rental record is a table of its own or a treatment row, so a team could add a rental table and the same tenancy would be recorded twice, once as a row and once as a record. (3) The legacy data table names recovery_case, v_ace_customer, v_ace_npa_asset, treatment, decision_log_entry, proceeds and rule_row and calls AMIS and ATS in process; the connection matrix gives rwb-treatment no link to rwb-source-data and no REST call to an in-scope service, and the Work Package declares no external and no integration dependency, so the target path for the AMIS rental record, the ATS mandate and the customer and asset facts is unstated. (4) TSD T5.1 lists INT-03 core bank (ALS), INT-26 NLEADS and INT-34 ACE common but no AMIS and no ATS interface, and the FSD names AMIS and ATS only as integration points. (5) No source names an event for the rental start, the receipt or the arrears hand-off: the catalogue gives the service one event (EV-10), and the receipt loop and the arrears test of REQ-S2-010 must reach rwb-payment and the case owner some other way. (6) The decision code the rental steps write to the local record is named by no source although every acceptance criterion of the legacy story ends with the record written with the rule version.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (treatment fields DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033, none of them a rental reference, a mandate reference or a mandate status) and T5.1 (external interfaces INT-03, INT-26 and INT-34 only); legacy RWB-E3-016 story line (opens the rental record, the auto-debit and the receipt loop), data table (recovery_case, v_ace_customer, treatment, decision_log_entry, proceeds, rule_row), endpoints (GET /api/recovery/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}) and test cases TC-E3-016-01 to TC-E3-016-05; FSD S2 v3 A2.16.2 (integration points AMIS, ATS; prerequisites FEAT-TRT-12) and A2.16.3.1 (VR-S2-016-1 with MSG-P1-001, R-DIL-32); Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-DIL-32 (ASSET_ON_BOOKS, BUYBACK_AGREED, create the rental record and set the auto-debit, RENTAL_RUNNING, systems ATS, AMIS, Workbench) and row R-DIL-34 (RENTAL_RUNNING, RENTAL_ARREARS, hand the asset to the disposal route, HANDED_TO_DISPOSAL); Epics 3 to 8 Specification v3 rows FEAT-TRT-16 (systems AMIS, ATS), FEAT-AST-23 (arrange a customer buy-back, S5) and FEAT-AST-24 (rent a held asset to a third party, S5); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 13 (S2 row: T and E to P3 and P7, E to S8, T to P5 and P8, N to ACE common, no cell for P1) and slide 42 (EV-10 TreatmentApproved, producer rwb-treatment, consumers rwb-comms and rwb-payment); Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01, DP-03, DP-05 and R7.2 s12
area: Contract and data: rental element set, rental table, AMIS and ATS path, receipt loop, rental event, decision code
owner_role: Tech lead of rwb-treatment with the S5 owner of the asset record, the P8 owner of payments and the P2 owner of the integration contract
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-011-1 to ASM-B2-S2-011-7 in RWB-S2-E3016-CON and apply it in RWB-S2-E3016-APP: the rental is a treatment row of type RENTAL with the rent in offer_amount, the first due date in first_due_date, the instalments paid in installments_paid and rentalRef, autoDebitRef and autoDebitStatus, and no rental table; the case status and the case task moved by the parent CaseWorkflow; the customer and NPA-asset facts carried on the case signal with no view read here; the AMIS rental record, the ATS mandate and the disposal hand-off requested through rwb-asset and rwb-integration and returned as facts; the matched receipt and the arrears event arriving from rwb-payment; no rental event published, the rental start reaching rwb-payment through the case events of rwb-case; and the decision code taken from the evaluated package. Confirm with the S5, P8 and P2 owners at the wave 2 contract freeze.

title: The rental element names, their domains, their absent-until rule and the absence of a rental event are not specified for the rwb-treatment contract
source: Legacy RWB-E3-016 sections 1 to 19 (04 User stories/Recovery Workbench User Stories Epics 3 to 8 v3.md, heading RWB-E3-016); FSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v3 A2.16.3; TSD S2 TDR, settlement and deed in lieu v2 T3.1, T3.2, T4 DEEDINLIEU and Appendix T-A; Recovery Workbench API Specification v4 (x-module S2); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 41, 42 and 43; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 rows R-DIL-32 to R-DIL-34; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01, DP-03 and DP-05, R7.2 s12
section: 3 Preconditions; 7 Acceptance criteria AC1 to AC6; 9 State transitions; 11 Data; 12.1; 12.3; 12.7; 13 Solution plan
description: One combined row for the rental contract. (1) The three facts the contract has to publish beside the published ones - the rental reference, the auto-debit mandate reference and the mandate status - carry no field identifier, no type and no list in the TSD, which ends at DF-TRT-033, and the API Specification publishes no treatment element for any of them, so the names in camelCase, the value domains and the absent-until rule are a working read rather than a sourced value. (2) The rent is carried as offer_amount (DF-TRT-007) and the first rental due date as first_due_date (DF-TRT-029), while no source states that the rental rent is the same figure as the amount agreed of a treatment nor that a rental has a first_due_date; the instalment count is carried as installments_paid (DF-TRT-032) although the legacy story never names it. (3) No list of values carries a mandate state, so the contract cannot fix the values of autoDebitStatus and must defer them to its owner. (4) The service is given one event in the catalogue (EV-10) and no source names a rental event, so the contract must publish none and the consumers must learn the rental start another way. (5) The schema registry mode and the AsyncAPI document are named, but the payload of the one event is named nowhere, which is why this contract refers to the envelope of RWB-S2-E3003-CON instead of restating it.
evidence: TSD S2 v2 T3.1 (fields DF-TRT-001 to DF-TRT-033; DF-TRT-007 offer_amount, DF-TRT-029 first_due_date and DF-TRT-032 installments_paid are the closest published facts) and T3.2 (LOV-TREATMENT includes RENTAL and BUY_BACK, LOV-TRT-OUTCOME has KEPT, BROKEN, COMPLETED, CANCELED and DECLINED, and no list carries a mandate state); legacy RWB-E3-016 endpoint table (GET /api/recovery/v1/treatments/{treatmentId}) and screen table (SCR-14 states Draft, submitted, approved, booked, broken; SCR-16 states Checks, appraisal, approved, transferred); FSD S2 v3 A2.16.3.1 (VR-S2-016-1 and R-DIL-32) and A2.16.3.3 (roles: runs unattended, sale officer); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slide 41 (rwb-treatment owns treatments, contracts, settlement and deed-in-lieu agreements, plan timers in schema rwb_treatment) and slide 42 row 10 (TreatmentApproved, producer rwb-treatment, topic rwb.treatment.events.v1, consumers rwb-comms and rwb-payment) with no payload column; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 row R-DIL-32 (systems ATS, AMIS, Workbench) and row R-DIL-34; Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-01 to DP-05 and R7.2 s12
area: Contract: rental element names and domains, absent-until rule, mandate state list, rental event, payload reference
owner_role: Contract author of rwb-treatment with the P8 owner of payments, the S5 owner of the asset record and the P3 owner of the case contract
proposed: Publish the working read of ASM-B2-S2-011-2 and ASM-B2-S2-011-7 in RWB-S2-E3016-CON at v1: the rental is a treatment row of type RENTAL with rentAmount in offer_amount (DF-TRT-007), firstRentDue in first_due_date (DF-TRT-029), installmentsPaid in installments_paid (DF-TRT-032), and rentalRef, autoDebitRef and autoDebitStatus with no published field, each absent until its step has answered, no rental table, the mandate state deferred to its owner, and no new event - the one event type of the service named and not reused on this path. Confirm with the P8, S5 and P3 owners at the wave 2 contract freeze.
